assumptions.choice: Used order.executed.price of the completed entry order in notify_order to set the initial stop-loss.
assumptions.reason: The specification states that stop-loss is set on entry based on entry_price; order.executed.price provides the exact fill price.

assumptions.choice: When an opposite signal occurs, the open position is closed via self.close() and any active stop-loss order is canceled. Reversal into a new position on the same bar is not performed.
assumptions.reason: Adheres to canonical defaults #2 (exit via self.close()), #3 (single position at a time), and #5 (guarding pending orders).

assumptions.choice: HMA, Bollinger Bands, and CrossOver indicators are computed using self.data.close.
assumptions.reason: Standard convention for moving average and volatility indicators when specified on intraday bar data.
